name: Core clock CLOCK:BMAL1 activation and CRY:PER repression
rationale: All members describe the core circadian transcription-translation loop (BMAL1:CLOCK modification and activation, CRY:PER repression), whereas the confusables centre on clock-linked metabolic, nuclear-receptor and glucocorticoid outputs or NPAS2 expression.

name: Somitogenesis and somite rostrocaudal patterning
rationale: All members concern somite formation and rostral/caudal compartment patterning (including the LFNG segmentation defect), distinguishing the theme from Notch glycosylation, axis-elongation and neural-plate/Hox patterning confusables.

qualifier: general cytokine and chemokine output program
name: General inflammatory cytokine and chemokine response program
rationale: Members are broad inflammatory-response gene programs of proinflammatory cytokines and chemokines (including MCP-1 production control), unlike confusables focused on monocyte chemotaxis, NF-kB myeloid activation or chemokine-receptor clusters.

name: Deoxynucleotide and pyrimidine catabolism with ADA/PNP deficiencies
rationale: Members cover breakdown and turnover of deoxyribonucleotides/deoxynucleosides and pyrimidine nucleotides, and the ADA and PNP deficiency members distinguish it from confusables dominated by de novo and salvage nucleotide biosynthesis.

name: Sex determination, gonad and reproductive tract development
rationale: Members span male sex determination, testis/Leydig differentiation and AMH signalling plus uterus, oviduct, vagina and genitalia development, separating it from germ-cell/seminiferous, prostate and mammary gland confusables.

name: Apoptotic nuclear dismantling with PAK-2p34 signalling
rationale: Members describe execution-phase apoptosis (DNA fragmentation, chromatin condensation, lamina breakdown), and the PAK-2p34 members are what the closely overlapping confusables lack.

qualifier: CORO1A-DEF6 network and proximal second-messenger signalling
name: Immunological synapse formation and proximal TCR second-messenger signalling
rationale: Members share T cell synapse assembly, polarity, raft localization and lymphocyte adhesion, and the CORO1A-DEF6 modules and second-messenger generation are what the adhesion/RHO GTPase confusables lack.

qualifier: nucleotide-sugar supply and transport for terminal elaboration
name: Nucleotide-sugar supply and transport for glycan elaboration
rationale: Members cover nucleotide-sugar synthesis (UDP-GlcNAc, GDP-fucose, CMP-sialic acid), SLC35 transporter defects and N-/O-glycan, sialyl, fucosyl and blood-group glycan building, unlike confusables centred on N-glycan trimming/catabolism or glycosphingolipids.

core: Oncogenic kinase and cytokine receptor signalling
name: Hematopoietic cytokine STAT5 and oncogenic ALK/FGFR/PDGFR signalling
rationale: Members combine EPO, TPO, IL-3, G-CSF and FLT3 STAT5/CBL signalling with oncogenic ALK, FGFR, PDGFR and LTK variants, whereas confusables are dominated by FLT3, KIT and ERBB2 drug-resistance mutants.

name: PPARG-driven white adipocyte differentiation and fat expansion
rationale: All members concern promotion of white fat cell differentiation, proliferation and adipose development via PPARG, distinguishing it from negative-regulation, PPARA/PGC-1alpha and LXR lipid-metabolism confusables.

qualifier: interstrand crosslink, fork stress and recombination intermediates
name: Replication-coupled crosslink and fork-stress repair by recombination
rationale: Members concern repair during replication stress (Fanconi/ICL repair, fork reversal, BIR, SDSA, recombination intermediate resolution, genotoxin responses), unlike confusables centred on DSB sensing, NHEJ, BRCA-mediated HR and ADP-ribosylation.

name: Coagulation cascade initiation and amplification
rationale: All members describe the core coagulation cascade from initiation through propagation, distinguishing it from fibrinolysis/platelet confusables and the F8/F9 defect and intrinsic-pathway confusables.

name: Placental labyrinth and chorionic trophoblast development
rationale: Members concern labyrinthine layer branching and vasculature, chorio-allantoic fusion and chorionic trophoblast proliferation, differentiation and migration, unlike confusables centred on trophoblast giant cells, decidualization, endoreduplication and early embryo lineages.

name: B cell and plasma cell immunoglobulin signatures
rationale: Members are B cell and plasma cell gene modules with immunoglobulins and plasma cell differentiation control, which distinguishes it from confusables built on B cell surface, memory, germinal centre and Tfh signatures.

name: HSF1 heat shock response and p53/anoikis cell-death regulation
rationale: Members combine HSF1 activation, attenuation and heat acclimation with chaperone-linked restraint of p53/DNA-damage apoptosis and anoikis control, which the UPRmt, pro-apoptotic p53 and stress-granule confusables lack.

core: Hindbrain and spinal cord neural development
qualifier: brainstem maturation and spinal motor neuron patterning
name: Brainstem development and spinal cord motor neuron patterning
rationale: Members span hindbrain/pons maturation and respiratory control with dorsoventral spinal cord patterning and motor/interneuron specification, distinguishing it from cranial nerve, midbrain dopaminergic and floor plate/notochord confusables.

name: Glutamine/glutamate and alanine anaplerosis of the TCA cycle
rationale: Members link glutamine, glutamate and alanine metabolism to 2-oxoglutarate, malate, oxaloacetate and pyruvate in the TCA cycle, whereas confusables emphasize the malate-aspartate shuttle, oxidative phosphorylation, aspartate and gluconeogenesis.

name: CSF1 macrophage and IL-6 JAK-STAT3/ERK signalling
rationale: Members combine M-CSF/CSF1 signalling and macrophage proliferation with IL-6 JAK-STAT3, SHC and ERK1/2 activation; the IL-6 and ERK members are what all confusables lack.

name: Outflow tract, great artery and semilunar valve morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern neural crest-dependent outflow tract septation, pharyngeal arch, pulmonary and coronary arteries and aortic/pulmonary valves, unlike confusables centred on second heart field cardiogenesis, AV valve/endocardial cushion formation or lung vascular BMP signalling.

name: Integrin-fibronectin adhesion and spreading with MET-FAK/tensin signalling
rationale: Members share integrin/syndecan-based substrate adhesion, fibronectin matrix, stress fibres and cell spreading/migration, and the MET-PTK2 and MET-tensin members are what the matrix, EMT and RHO effector confusables lack.

qualifier: SUMO processing, E1-E2 conjugation and desumoylation
name: SUMO conjugation cascade, desumoylation and substrate SUMOylation
rationale: All members concern the SUMO pathway, and SUMO maturation, E1/E2 transfer and desumoylation are what the substrate-only SUMOylation and PML/nuclear transport confusables lack.

qualifier: fear and responses to CRH and corticosterone
name: Stress and fear responses to CRH and corticosterone
rationale: All members describe organismal stress responses (adaptation syndrome, fear, CRH and corticosterone responses), distinguishing it from HPA hormone secretion, addiction/social behaviour and sleep-neuropeptide confusables.

qualifier: mesendoderm specification and early gut morphogenesis
name: Gastrulation, mesendoderm specification and early gut morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover primitive streak, gastrulation EMT and migration, mesoderm/endoderm specification, pluripotency exit and gut tube morphogenesis, distinguishing it from left/right asymmetry and heart field cardiogenesis confusables.

core: Cellular metal and oxidative stress response
qualifier: metallothionein metal binding and ROS detoxification
name: Metallothionein metal response and ROS detoxification
rationale: Members join MTF1/metallothionein responses to zinc, copper, manganese and iron with ROS detoxification, redox homeostasis and HMOX1, whereas confusables cover heavy-metal transport/detoxification only or nitrosative and peroxide responses only.

core: Lipid droplet triglyceride storage and mobilization
name: Lipid droplet triglyceride mobilization and fatty acid oxidation
rationale: Members span lipid droplet formation, fusion, lipolysis and lipophagy with fatty acid import, carnitine shuttle and beta-oxidation control (plus adipokine signalling), unlike confusables focused on triglyceride and phospholipid biosynthesis and adipogenesis.
